answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust anchor for Sybil resistance in multi-agent systems, requiring agents to stake collateral to validate transactions. This velvet glove of economic incentives ensures that the cost of generating identities scales linearly with capital, making a massive Sybil attack prohibitively expensive. Like a sentinel raven watching the network, the protocol slashes the stake of any node attempting to flood the consensus layer with fraudulent identities, effectively pricing out malicious actors.
